title: tracekit trace event
description: One line of a fleet trace (JSONL). Provider-neutral: Claude/OpenAI/Gemini runs normalise to this. Only these fields are read by the scorer; implementations may log more, but extra fields are payload and are dropped before a trace becomes a public fixture.

event_id.description: Globally-unique id; enables idempotent dedup across redundant delivery rails.

proposal_id.description: Groups all events of one task/decision lifecycle.

type.description: State-machine transition. Generic agent runs map their own steps onto these (see ADAPTER-ANGLE.md).

actor.description: Which agent/machine emitted the event. Sanitised to a role (hub/laptop-1/anchor/...) in public fixtures.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Defines causal order within a proposal.

reversible.description: Advisory: whether the action can be cheaply undone.
